title: [Sutana's Designs, Floor Decor]
description: Rugs and woven mats soften the floor beneath careful arrangements of sculpted figures and low furnishings.  Potted plants add subtle color among stone urns, wooden stools, and artful curios, their forms casting gentle shadows in the lantern light.  Glass and metal accents create a balanced display of comfort, craft, and whimsy viewable from every angle.
